item.title: TikTok influencer Paige Carlene breaks silence after followers ask for her late baby’s belongings during her raw grief
item.description: Influencer Paige Carlene asked followers to stop requesting her late son Austin’s baby items, saying her grief is still raw. Austin died at 31 days old after being born at 25 weeks. Paige explained that his belongings hold deep meaning and help her family feel close to him while they heal.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: 16 top YouTube channels uploading AI content deleted, report finds
item.description: YouTube is actively purging popular AI-generated channels, removing 16 of the top 100 for low-quality, repetitive content. This move, targeting channels with millions of subscribers and billions of views, aims to curb automated spam, protect genuine creators, and elevate the platform's overall content quality. YouTube is leveraging existing anti-spam tools to ensure a fairer environment for original creators.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Save A Fox YouTube channel confirms passing of Finnegan the Fox months after his death
item.description: Finnegan the Fox, a star of Save A Fox's YouTube channel, has passed away. The news was shared by Ethan Frankamp, widower of founder Mikayla Raines. Finnegan's death occurred two months prior, with the family needing time to grieve multiple losses. He was also known for providing vocal sounds for Kiriko in Overwatch 2.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: DOJ Email Release On Musk: New files show Musk, Epstein planned island visit; daughter recalls childhood trips
item.description: Newly revealed documents show Elon Musk's attempts to visit Jeffrey Epstein's island around the holidays. Emails detail cordial exchanges and discussions about parties. Musk's estranged daughter, Vivian Wilson, shared a childhood memory of traveling in the same Caribbean region during holidays, adding a personal, unsettling layer to the revelations. It remains unconfirmed if Musk ever visited the island.

item.title: The McCaughey septuplets: The world’s first seven babies born together; where are they now?
item.description: More than 25 years after making history as the first surviving septuplets, the McCaughey siblings have built independent lives with careers, marriages, and children. Born in 1997 after fertility treatment, they faced medical risks and intense public attention. Today, the family embraces quieter routines, close bonds, and shared memories, proving their extraordinary childhood gave way to ordinary, fulfilling adulthood.

item.title: What happened to the ‘ghost boy’ who spent more than a decade locked inside his own body
item.description: South African man Martin Pistorius spent more than a decade fully conscious but unable to move or speak after a childhood illness left him misdiagnosed as vegetative. Trapped inside his body, he eventually regained communication through assistive technology. Now a father, professional and disability advocate, his story challenges assumptions about awareness, dignity and life with severe disability.

item.title: Twitch streamer Aspen Kartier arrested on animal cruelty charge after viral dog video
item.description: Twitch streamer Aspen Kartier, also known as Aspen Easterling, was arrested and charged with animal cruelty after a video surfaced showing her handling her puppy roughly during a livestream. The 19-year-old was taken into custody following multiple public complaints and an investigation. Her three-month-old Maltipoo puppy was found in good health and taken by animal control.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: MrBeast bribes goalkeeper in unusual charity football stunt at Match for Hope 2026
item.description: YouTube star MrBeast created a viral moment during a charity football match in Doha when he jokingly appeared to bribe a goalkeeper with $10,000 before taking a penalty. The goalkeeper refused, and MrBeast converted the spot kick. The playful stunt drew global attention while amplifying the Match for Hope event’s charitable mission.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: “Horrified by the video”: PETA responds to disturbing dog abuse claims involving Twitch streamer Aspen Kartier
item.description: PETA responded forcefully after Aspen Kartier faced dog abuse allegations that led Twitch to mark her channel as temporarily unavailable. Viral clips sparked outrage, prompting PETA to urge authorities to investigate, prosecute if warranted, and ensure the dog is removed to a safe, loving home.

item.title: Mother dies after arm amputation as doctors dismiss blackened hand as ‘newspaper ink’
item.description: A 52-year-old Edinburgh mother, Lorraine Pettie, suffered rapid necrosis in her right hand after medical staff dismissed the darkening as bruising, or even newspaper ink. Despite urgent care visits, her condition worsened, leading to amputation. She later died from complications including heart disease and diabetes. Her family say earlier intervention might have saved her arm, highlighting failings in timely diagnosis.
